stage: Stage 1 / Month 1 — Prove the Core Concept
goal: Turn vague trading ideas into strict, schema-based StrategySpecs without inventing missing rules.
done_when: 10-20 different BTC/ETH trading ideas become valid StrategySpec drafts, or clear clarification questions when rules are missing.

items.text: Define minimum StrategySpec fields: market, timeframe, direction, entry, exit, risk, assumptions
Draft 10-20 realistic BTC/ETH strategy ideas incl. vague and incomplete examples
Implement/document compiler path: natural language -> strict JSON/Pydantic output
Add clarification rules for missing breakout, volume, exit, timeframe, risk definitions
Confirm invalid/missing values become questions or errors, never invented defaults
Test same input twice, compare schema consistency
Test impossible/unsafe requests, record expected rejection or clarification
Pick 3 demo examples showing vague idea -> structured StrategySpec
